notes.name: Paul Kavanagh
notes.who: Yacht chef ( not currently on board a programme until next season)
notes.alt: Paul Kavanagh in short-sleeved chef whites, arms crossed, on a quay in front of a white superyacht
notes.moment: So many moments to choose but definitely the multi purpose chocolate espuma, the raspberry clouds and the meringue work...not to mention the liquid nitrogen yoghurt espuma lollipops, all incredible.
notes.note:
It was amazing to learn from Martin and meet like minded talented chefs, such a wealth of knowledge to share between us. 
Makes you think about your own food ideas in different ways also. This course was very special indeed.

Looking forward to the next possibilities on this Educated Travellers platform. 

I think sushi in Japan for sure. 

Top tier Thai cooking ( not the average tourist style basic Thai food course we see everywhere in thailand.) 

I also think for chefs, a course in basic content creation and digital awareness on how to create captivating food preparation and photography to increase your online portfolio and presentation.... With a.i changeing everything now I think employers will look for real footage/pics from aspiring chefs.
notes.line: This course was very special indeed.

notes.name: Luigi Fumarola
notes.alt: Luigi Fumarola, curly-haired, in a double-breasted chef jacket against a pale wall

notes.name: Jaimee Kivell
notes.alt: Jaimee Kivell in a black chef jacket, smiling, on a marina quay with yachts and a sandstone harbour town behind her
notes.moment: Learning from Martin has forever changed the way I view food, its history, and its future
notes.note: The entire experience was great and immersive from arrival. Everyone was there because they were truly interested in learning. Martin was an incredible teacher and I felt he really cared about us taking away something we could actually use whilst still making sure we understood the science behind it all, so we could then go on to make our own creations. It was well organised by Arrnaud, he was always so communicative throughout the whole process and also a genuine and friendly guy, everyone was made to feel welcome. It was a fantastic experience.
notes.line: Learning from Martin has forever changed the way I view food, its history, and its future

notes.name: Alex
notes.who: World traveling private chef currently on a 35 meter Ocean Alexander in the Caribbean
notes.alt: Alex in chef whites beside Martin Lippo at the steel bench of the Vakuum kitchen, both looking down at a recipe sheet
notes.moment: I think that the way we all bonded in the classroom made every moment memorable. The liquid nitrogen popcorn was pretty sick
notes.note: Wow wow wow what an incredible week shared with an incredible teacher, friends and city. This is an experience i will carry with me for a lifetime on all aspects. This was my first time in Barcelona and the class was beyond anything I had expected!
notes.line: This was my first time in Barcelona and the class was beyond anything I had expected!

notes.alt: Artem in a black chef jacket at the steel bench of the Vakuum kitchen, blending a yellow mixture in a measuring jug
notes.moment: The personalized welcome drink in a cup you do yourself and that is eatable.
notes.note: The most impressive thing was the team behind and that all the techniques were actually very easy to do though they appeared very special.
notes.line: The most impressive thing was the team behind and that all the techniques were actually very easy to do though they appeared very special.

notes.name: Nikki Forster
notes.who: Chef for Psychotherapy Retreats • Conceptual Dining • Holidays on land and sea
notes.alt: Nikki in a tan linen jacket beside Martín at the steel bench of the Vakuum kitchen, liquid nitrogen fog rolling over it as they pour into a jug
notes.moment: Using liquid nitrogen was so fun to learn, i dreamed about it hahaha
notes.note: Martin is a true inspiration, to learn these techniques from a punk drummer rockstar travel chef is a true blessing. Arnauld, Thank you for this experience! Dining at great restaurants after class made the week so fun and personal, the whole class is genuine good people to keep contact with. Much love and forever grateful!
notes.line: Martin is a true inspiration, to learn these techniques from a punk drummer rockstar travel chef is a true blessing.
